name: WorkOS Skill Router
headline: Gemini Integration & Contextual Summarization:
short_description: This skill enables users to integrate Google Workspace with Gemini for enhanced productivity. Users can summarize unread emails or video content and contextualize the information to make it actionable for personal or professional projects.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The Gemini Integration & Contextual Summarization skill is designed to enhance productivity by integrating Google Workspace with Gemini. This skill enables users to summarize unread emails and video content, transforming lengthy information into actionable insights. By contextualizing the data, users can make informed decisions for both personal and professional projects, streamlining their workflow and improving efficiency. One of the key benefits of this skill is its ability to prioritize urgent communications. Users can quickly summarize and respond to critical emails, ensuring that important messages are not overlooked. Additionally, the skill allows for the extraction of key takeaways from lengthy video content, making it easier to digest and utilize information. This can save users significant time that would otherwise be spent sifting through extensive materials, ultimately leading to more productive work sessions. This skill is particularly beneficial for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who frequently engage with large volumes of information. By automating the summarization process, these professionals can focus on their core tasks while still staying informed. The practical use cases include creating step-by-step process documents from screen recordings and extracting essential points from meetings or webinars, which can enhance team collaboration and project execution. With an intermediate difficulty level, the Gemini Integration & Contextual Summarization skill can be implemented in approximately 30 minutes. Users will need a basic understanding of Google Workspace and Gemini to maximize the benefits of this integration. By incorporating this skill into AI-first workflows, organizations can leverage automation to enhance productivity and streamline processes, ultimately leading to better outcomes and faster project delivery.
Prioritize urgent emails with summaries and responses.
Extract and contextualize key takeaways from lengthy videos.
Create step-by-step process documents from screen recordings.
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
Integrate your [GOOGLE_SERVICE] with Gemini. Use Gemini to [ACTION] and summarize [CONTENT_TYPE]. Provide context by specifying your role as [USER_ROLE] and your goal [USER_GOAL]. For email summaries, consider priorities and draft responses. For video summaries, connect implications to your projects. Format the output as actionable insights or process documents.
```
Copy

```
Summary of unread emails:
1. Email from [Sender] regarding [Subject]. Summary: [Brief Summary]. Action: Respond by [Deadline].
2. Email from [Sender] regarding [Subject]. Summary: [Brief Summary]. Action: Schedule meeting.

Video Takeaways: Key insights related to [Project] and recommendations are provided along with timestamps for easier reference and sharing with the team.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
